title: Story
summary: SEKOYA platform page giving the selection code, selection year and selection location for the SEKOYA varieties: Beauty 'FCM12-097' (Mexico 2012), Pop 'FCM14-052' (Mexico 2014), Grande 'FC13-122' (2013), Crunch 'FC13-083' (Oregon 2013) and Fiesta 'FC13-113' (debut 2023).
why_it_matters: Primary owner-published mapping from SEKOYA brand names to breeding selection codes. Without this mapping, brand-level trade reporting cannot be joined to patent and plant breeders' rights records.

reading.rationale: Identity resolution across brand names and selection codes is a prerequisite for the whole dataset.

testing.rationale: Not directly testable, but it identifies which codes to request for trialling.

commercial_position.rationale: Mapping brands to codes reveals which genetics a competitor has actually placed in its premium tier.

monitoring.rationale: New SEKOYA members and varieties are added over time.
